description: Synthetic weather, air-quality, alert and rule fixture for package validation; not an evaluation task.

sources.description: Places, issuances, observations, alerts and rules written by the seeded generator. All places are fictional, with plausible but not real coordinates, so no record implies conditions at a real location.
AQI breakpoint tables (PM2.5 2024 revision, PM10, 8-hour O3) used by src/aqi.cjs; a U.S. federal government work in the public domain.
Solar position equations used by src/solar.cjs; NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory, public domain.

transformations: All times are RFC 3339 with UTC offsets; values are stored in metric units.

review.notes: Automatic checks do not replace human review of realism, wording and provenance.
